svg.title: LCD display mockup
svg.desc: Conceptual mockups of the 16 by 2 LCD for normal operation in simulation, a sensor error, and boot. Not a photograph.
svg.text: LCD layout (conceptual render, not a photograph)
Strings from src/main.cpp DisplayTask. "S" in the last column marks simulation builds. Values shown are examples.
